title: Announcing: tiger-reserve trips

scenes.headline: Sloth bears rip open termite nests and vacuum up the insects
Learn to read the whole forest, not just look for stripes

caption:
Tiger-reserve trips are here

The puffing and sucking of a sloth bear feeding at a termite mound can be heard up to about 185 m away.

Source: Animal Diversity Web. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Launch post from real Indian wild footage (Rajaji leopard, Bor sloth bear, Corbett peafowl) - positions the trips as 'more than tigers' so we never promise a sighting. Confirm the programme before posting.
